summary: After 6 complete training runs using optimizer tuning approach: optimal configuration is EMBEDDING_LR=0.8 (+33%), MATRIX_LR=0.05 (+25%), and ADAM_BETAS=(0.82, 0.95), achieving val_bpb 0.996370. This represents 0.097% improvement over baseline 0.997333. Key findings: (1) Embedding LR is primary high-leverage parameter; (2) Adam beta1 reduction from 0.8 to 0.82 provides further refinement; (3) Matrix LR increase synergizes well with embedding LR boost; (4) Parameter search showed diminishing returns plateau around 0.996694, but continued exploration of Adam betas unlocked further gains to 0.996370. Architecture baseline was well-optimized; aggressive single-parameter changes hurt performance, but carefully balanced adjustments across multiple parameters improve results.
